name: Vigilante Mech Renegade
body:
Although the production and use of mechs is primarily controlled by powerful nations, there exist a number of rogue pilots who have learned to construct and pilot mechs to great effect. These pilots, known for calling and customizing their mechs with psionic abilities, often operate in secret as criminals or vigilantes.

Delayed Vigilante Specialization

The morphmech renegade does not select a vigilante specialization until 2nd level.

This alters vigilante specialization.

Bonded Mech

The morphmech renegade gains a bonded mech, treating his class level as his pilot level.

This replaces the vigilante talents gained at 2nd, 6th, 10th, 14th, and 18th levels.

Pilot’s Entrance (Su)

Starting at 5th level, whenever the morphmech renegade assumes his vigilante identity, he may call his mech to his location as part of the action used to change identities. The mech appears as soon as the change is complete, and the morphmech renegade may enter his mech as a free action. This ability does not work if either the mech or the morphmech renegade is in an area where teleportation does not function.

This replaces startling appearance.

Morphic Mech (Ps)

Starting at 11th level, the morphmech renegade gains the ability to use reconfiguration* as a psi-like ability a number of times per day equal to 1/2 his vigilante level.

This replaces frightening appearance.

Turbo Morph (Ps)

At 17th level, the morphmech renegade may expend two uses of his reconfiguration psilike ability to use the ability as a swift action. Alternatively, he may expend three uses to use mechanical combination* as a psi-like ability as a swift action with a manifester level equal to his vigilante level.

This ability replaces stunning appearance.
